items.title: Is Wall Street buying Intel's comeback story after blowout Q2 earnings?
items.summary: Intel stock (INTC), which initially surged following its second quarter earnings yesterday, is trying to hold onto some of its gains Friday morning. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré and Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick to discuss Intel's earnings release, outlook, and performance of its various business segments.

items.title: Lisa Su unveils AMD's AI roadmap, calling Helios 'the best AI rack in the world'
items.summary: AMD (AMD) CEO Lisa Su took the stage at Advancing AI 2026 to unveil the chipmaker's latest AI roadmap, highlighting next-generation CPUs, GPUs, and AI rack-scale systems. During the keynote, Su touted the company's upcoming Helios platform, calling it "simply the best AI rack in the world" as AMD ramps up its challenge to rivals, including Nvidia (NVDA), in the AI infrastructure race.

items.title: Could AMD's new Helios AI rack system push it to outperform Nvidia?
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) unveiled its latest AI infrastructure product, the Helios rackscale systems for data centers. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley outlines AMD's latest raft of microprocessors and other products that aim to put it in direct competition with chip competitor Nvidia (NVDA). AMD is currently scheduled to report second quarter earnings on Tuesday, August 4, well ahead of Nvidia's earnings release expected out on Wednesday, August 26.
